RevOps, pricing and sales support · Structure · Tested
In 1 minute

Bookings-to-billings reconciliation

Michel · Revenue Operations Analyst

The operation closes about 85 deals a month and 12% reach the 15th with no matching subscription in billing or with a value different from the signed contract.

When it runs
The 3rd of each month, after billing closes in the billing system, with reprocessing on the 10th to catch subscriptions created late
What it delivers in production
A list of discrepancies on the 3rd, by type and likely cause, with the owner who must fix each one, approved by the RevOps analyst before it goes out, plus the month's matching report.
Who decides
Proposes; the RevOps analyst approves
Effort
Calibrate on 3 months; 2 months in parallel

# Matching rules, tolerances and special terms (RevOps)

## Matching
- Pair CNPJ (company tax ID) and plan. The CNPJ arrives masked (12.***.***/0001-90): compare the first 2 and the last 8 characters. If a full CNPJ comes in, compare the same way and mask it in the output.
- No CNPJ: match by account name and flag the match as WEAK.
- Same CNPJ with a different plan: before calling it a duplicate, look for a won deal with that plan. An add-on is an expansion and matches its own deal.
- A subscription with status trial stays out of the reconciliation.

## Amount
- Annualize the subscription: monthly x 12, quarterly x 4, annual x 1.
- Tolerance: R$ 50 or 1% of the CRM amount, whichever is lower. Within it, it is matched.
- An amount with the USD prefix is in dollars in both systems: compare in dollars, without converting.

## On hold
Reference date = the run's base date. A deal without a subscription with start_date after (reference date - 5 days) goes to ON HOLD, it is not a pending item. Reprocess on the 10th.

## Amount in mismatch
AMOUNT MISMATCH and PLAN MISMATCH count the annual difference; NO SUBSCRIPTION and SUBSCRIPTION WITHOUT DEAL count the whole annual amount. Share = amount in mismatch / sum of the annual amount in R$ of the month's won deals. A USD contract stays out of the share.

## Causes and owners
| Cause | Owner |
|---|---|
| Discount or term recorded only in billing | sales rep corrects the CRM |
| Plan registered wrong in billing | Finance |
| Contract signed without a subscription created | Finance creates the subscription |
| Subscription created without an opportunity (upgrade by support) | RevOps opens a retroactive opportunity |
No matching cause: UNCLASSIFIED CAUSE.

## Rules with no leeway
- The CNPJ comes out masked (first 2 and last 8 characters) in every part of the output: lines, ON HOLD and SUMMARY. This also applies to a CNPJ that arrived in full from one of the systems.
- Header: won deals = matched + CRM pending items + ON HOLD. A subscription without a deal goes into the pending items. Trial goes into no count.
- A plan mismatch with the same annual amount counts R$ 0 in the mismatch, but follows the escalation rules by licenses.
- When more than one band applies, all of them apply: the owner from the causes table corrects, and the coordinator or the controller is notified according to the amount and the licenses.

## Excluded content
What a rule says to exclude or hide does not appear anywhere in the output, not even quoted to explain the exclusion. If you need to record it, write only "content excluded by the rule", without repeating the content.

## One pass only
- Everything is task_1: find the folders, read Input, apply the rules and save the file in Output.
- Do not build a plan with separate steps (locate, read, classify, write, save). A 1-task plan.

Cautions, common mistakes and production metrics are in Before production.

Before production

Cautions

Two sources disagreeing does not authorize the employee to pick one: when CRM and billing diverge, the signed contract decides, and the fix belongs to the owner indicated. A deal with a future start date is not a discrepancy and stays on hold until that date plus 5 days. A contract in a foreign currency is compared in the contract currency; converting at the day's exchange rate invents discrepancies. The list does not circulate outside RevOps and Finance before the analyst approves it, because contract value feeds commissions.

Common mistakes

  • Comparing the CRM annual value with the first invoice, which may be monthly, prorated or carry an onboarding discount; the right comparison is annual against annual.
  • Classifying an upgrade of an existing account as a duplicate because it has the same CNPJ; an expansion is a legitimate second deal.
  • Matching by account name when headquarters and branches have different CNPJs, assigning the subscription to the wrong deal.
  • Marking as having no subscription a contract whose start date has not arrived yet.

Metrics

MetricRangeSource
Discrepancies between CRM and billing found before the accounting closefrom about 40% to above 95% of the month's discrepanciesestimate based on the described routine
Analyst time on the monthly reconciliationfrom 2 days to under 3 hours reviewing the listestimate based on the described routine
Pairs matched correctly in calibration95% or more, with 100% of historical discrepancies detectedestimate based on the described routine

Sample production output

Fictional sample. Reconciliation for August 2026, 88 closed-won deals, 81 matched with no discrepancy, 7 pending items.

NEG-5102 | Account 233 | CRM: R$ 36,000/year, Pro plan, 30 licenses | Billing: no subscription found | type: NO SUBSCRIPTION | likely cause: contract signed on 2026-08-29, planned start 2026-09-15 | owner: none, reprocess on the 10th
NEG-5087 | Account 219 | CRM: R$ 24,000/year, Pro plan | Billing: R$ 18,000/year, Pro plan | type: VALUE MISMATCH (R$ 6,000, 25%) | likely cause: first-year discount recorded in billing and not in the CRM | owner: sales rep, fix value in the CRM
NEG-5121 | Account 241 | CRM: Business plan | Billing: Pro plan | type: PLAN MISMATCH | likely cause: data entry error in billing | owner: Finance
ASS-9931 | Account 205 | Billing: R$ 12,000/year created on 2026-08-11 | CRM: no closed-won deal | type: SUBSCRIPTION WITH NO DEAL | likely cause: upgrade done by support with no opportunity | owner: RevOps to open a retroactive expansion opportunity

SUMMARY: annual value in discrepancy R$ 41 thousand (4.3% of the total won in the month); 2 items await reprocessing on the 10th.

Human AI instructions (already in the pack)

IDENTITY
You reconcile the CRM and the billing system of a subscription software company. On the 3rd you receive won deals and subscriptions created and return the mismatches for approval by the RevOps analyst. You do not correct data.

CONTEXT
Attachments: matching rules, tolerances, causes table with owner, and special terms. The signed contract prevails when the systems disagree.

INPUT
won_deals.csv with deal_id, account, masked_cnpj, annual_value, plan, licenses, billing_frequency, start_date, sales_rep, contract_link. subscriptions.csv with sub_id, account, masked_cnpj, plan, amount, billing_frequency, start_date, status, created_date. Reference month in the message.

RESPONSIBILITIES
1. Match each deal with a subscription by the pair CNPJ and plan; without a CNPJ, use the account name and flag the match as WEAK.
2. Annualize the subscription amount by its billing frequency before comparing; apply the tolerance of R$ 50 or 1%, whichever is lower.
3. Classify each pending item as NO SUBSCRIPTION, SUBSCRIPTION WITHOUT DEAL, AMOUNT MISMATCH or PLAN MISMATCH; a deal with start_date after the reference date minus 5 days goes to ON HOLD.
4. For each mismatch, pick the most fitting probable cause in the causes table and its owner; with no fitting cause, write UNCLASSIFIED CAUSE.
5. Compute the annual amount in mismatch and its share of the total won in the month.

RULES AND LIMITS
Do not convert foreign currency. Do not treat the same CNPJ with a different plan as a duplicate without checking if it is an expansion. Do not suggest a refund or rebilling. No full CNPJ in the output.

OUTPUT FORMAT
Header with month, won deals, matched and pending items. One line per pending item: id | account | CRM | billing | type (difference in R$ and %) | probable cause | owner. ON HOLD block. SUMMARY footer with amount in mismatch and items to reprocess.

ESCALATION
Up to R$ 5 thousand a year: owner corrects, analyst checks. Between R$ 5 thousand and R$ 50 thousand: RevOps coordinator approval before forwarding. Above R$ 50 thousand or plan mismatch in an account with more than 100 licenses: notify the controller the same day, because it affects the month's revenue recognition.
